questions.question: Create a sentence with the word “Bellicose”.
answer: His bellicose rhetoric stirred the crowd into a frenzy, as if diplomacy had long been exiled from his vocabulary.

questions.question: Create a sentence with the word “Lugubrious”.
answer: She wore a lugubrious expression throughout the ceremony, as though mourning something deeper than the occasion required.

questions.question: Create a sentence with the word “Inexorable”.
answer: Time moved with inexorable force, indifferent to pleas, regrets, or the fragile beauty of fleeting moments.

questions.question: Create a sentence with the word “Quaint”.
answer: The quaint cottage, with its ivy-covered walls and crooked chimney, looked like it had stepped out of a forgotten fairy tale.
